description: Αρχείο καταγραφής των θέσεων αποκλειστικής στάθμευσης δικύκλων του Δήμου Θεσσαλονίκης is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Τμήμα Κυκλοφοριακού Σχεδιασμού. De dataset bevat de exclusieve parkeerplaatsen voor tweewielers van de gemeente Thessaloniki. Coverage: Τμήμα Κυκλοφοριακού Σχεδιασμού. The portal shows the English title as "Divriteņu transportlīdzekļu stāvvietu reģistrs Saloniku pašvaldībā" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Τμήμα Κυκλοφοριακού Σχεδιασμού. Its keywords include Δίκυκλα, repository.data.gov.gr, Από μετάπτωση, Θέσεισ στάθμευσησ. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLS. The listing shows 2026-02-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
